verifications.note: Note 1 (Organization) pipeline-systems table, row 'Tuscarora ... 305 miles ... Extends between the GTN pipeline near Malin, Oregon to its terminus near Reno, Nevada and delivers natural gas in northeastern California and northwestern Nevada' -- Ownership column value '100 percent', in the same table row as the pipeline named 'Tuscarora' (short form the Partnership uses for Tuscarora Gas Transmission Company throughout this filing).

"Tuscarora is operated by a subsidiary of TC Energy Corporation. TC PipeLines, LP owns 100 percent of Tuscarora." (page is TC Energy's FERC Standards-of-Conduct informational posting for Tuscarora Gas Transmission Company)

"[Tuscarora Gas Pipeline] ... is owned by Tuscarora Gas Transmission Company which in turn is 100% owned by TC PipeLines, LP." Also gives history: originally owned jointly by Sierra Pacific Resources and TransCanada Corporation from 1995; TC PipeLines, LP acquired Sierra Pacific's remaining interest in 2007-2008, since when ownership has been 100% TC PipeLines, LP.

resolutions.researcher_notes: Recorded Owner1='TC PipeLines LP' / Owner1%='100.00%' confirmed on three sources: TC PipeLines, LP's own Q4 2024 consolidated financial statements (SEC-filed, tcenergy.com-hosted) carry an ownership table listing Tuscarora at 100 percent alongside the partnership's other seven pipelines (already on this row for Status [ref]); TC Energy's tcplus.com FERC-mandated informational posting for Tuscarora states the same fact in prose (already on this row for Operator/PipelineType [ref]); and the English-Wikipedia article on this pipeline (via the gem.wiki seed citation's bit.ly link, which resolves to en.wikipedia.org -- a genuinely independent third party, not GEM) states '100% owned by TC PipeLines, LP' and additionally corroborates the ownership history (Sierra Pacific Resources' remaining interest bought out by TC PipeLines, LP in 2007-2008, consistent with a clean 100% single-owner cap table today, no other owner rows owed). No second owner/percentage exists to record -- Owner2+ correctly blank. Federal Register notice of application and the SEC EDGAR TC PipeLines LP press-release exhibit (tm206443d5_ex99.htm, opened for this pass) were also read to exhaustion but neither states an ownership percentage for Tuscarora specifically (the Federal Register notice only identifies the applicant's Houston address/counsel; the 2019Q3 press release lists Tuscarora among TC PipeLines LP's consolidated subsidiaries and 'eight ... pipelines' but gives no per-asset percentage) -- not cited as refs for this unit, no new sourcing found there beyond what's already on the row.
